verdict.rationale: Gitea's own GitHub README says it provides an official CLI tool called tea, and a probe confirms the official CLI is documented at gitea.com/gitea/tea. That establishes a first-party CLI exists, but the pack contains nothing on its depth. Missing for 10: documented command coverage, agent-friendly features such as machine-readable or JSON output and non-interactive auth, and independent hands-on corroboration of CLI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: We provide an official go-sdk, a CLI tool called tea and an action runner for Gitea Action.
